modules.module_title: Monitor and maintain machine learning models post- — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Implement systems to continuously monitor the performance of deployed machine learning models.
Use monitoring tools to collect and visualize key performance metrics such as accuracy and latency.
Define relevant key performance indicators and set up alerts for issues like performance drops or increased prediction latency
Log prediction inputs outputs and metadata to facilitate troubleshooting and diagnostics.
Monitor for changes in data distribution over time using statistical tests and evaluate their impact on model performance
Regularly assess the model’s predictive accuracy and other metrics to ensure it maintains expected performance levels

Analyze errors such as false positives and false negatives to identify limitations and areas for improvement
